findings: The operator corrected the first session as ordinary Page Up, not M1; it is retained as a negative control.
M1 and M2 emit Page Up/Page Down usages while the separate Fn state is active.
M3, M4, and M5 emit exact PID 02C6 prefixes 040A0300, 040AD300, and 040AD400.
Fn+P emits 01001300 while the Fn state remains active.
Completion-message typing occurred after each correlated action and is excluded from the evidence.
